text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Thanksgiving staples, food stalls are a must!
Like drink stands and sweets booths!

Hearing voices, I peeked inside the classroom...
The students were discussing their booth for the Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member B
text_block_list.text: A classic spot would be a coffee shop or café, but what do you think, Pearl-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I suppose... sticking with the classics isn't bad.
However, you can experience the classics anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They're coming all the way out to the Fan Appreciation Festival, after all.
Don't you want to give them an experience they can't get anywhere else?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Think wider! More flexibly!
Let's break free of common sense and think outside the box!

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
An experience you can't get anywhere else...
Right, that sounds way more fun!
With a single remark from Seeking the Pearl, the discussion about the Fan Appreciation Festival kicked into high gear――

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—In short: the "Arm-Power Merry-Go-Round"!
A handmade attraction powered entirely
by Umamusume arm strength! Well, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we add some other attractions too?
Like a "Raw Strength Teacups" ride!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you over there have an idea too?
Go ahead, feel free to say whatever comes to mind.
choice_data_list: It might be tough to pull off, though……
That's an interesting idea you came up with!
That's a pretty interesting idea you've come up with!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you over there have an idea too?
Go ahead, feel free to say whatever comes to mind.
choice_data_list: It might be tough to pull off, though……
That's an interesting idea you came up with!
That's a pretty interesting idea you've come up with!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I doubt it will be simple.
However—there is certainly ample potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then all that's left is to think.
To figure out concrete ways to make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we put our heads together, a great idea is bound to come up!
Don't worry, we will definitely make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, and that's all thanks to everyone unleashing their true potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After all, those girls
possess such incredible potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we all give it our absolute best, I know
this will be the greatest Fan Appreciation Festival ever!
